quest.title: Neko Is a Cat: Wooden Shelf
quest.description: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Another quiet day today...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Ah, arrived, have you? I slept most well last night after you cleaned the shrine... meow, meow...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Those two people in green came by for a stroll yesterday as well.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: That said, no other humans besides them came to pay their respects here. Very strange...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: But when those two green humans came by, they seemed quite interested in that wooden rack there, meow.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I recall Hibiki calling the rack itself a "Prayer Rack," and these small wooden blocks "Prayer Plaques." It just so happened that many people frequented this shrine on the account of this wooden rack.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hmm... Does this mean that humans love wood? It is true that many visitors would go to that wooden rack to hang small wooden blocks after offering up some Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I—I don't think it's because they love the wood...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Is that so? Then... did they do it because they dislike wood? ...To punish the wood, perhaps?

choices.text: The wood is really not the important part...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: ...Whatever the case may be, the rack is now in a sorry state and has been left wanting for more wooden blocks.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Though I cannot claim to understand the relationship between humans and wood, a shrine must have these all the same.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: It must be the ruination of the rack and the shrine running out of wood that no one comes by anymore.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: As such, I must ask another thing of you — to fix that wooden rack.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that you mention it, we should have some leftover material from when we fixed that Offering Box, right?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Of such things, I cannot be sure... Why do you humans love wood so much, anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, you know what, never mind... Paimon remembers that we have some spares. Let's look around a bit.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Whatever the case may be, I shall leave the matter of the wooden shelf to you. This shrine will not take care of itself, after all, meow.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Once that box and shelf are both fixed, the number of humans coming here should swell.

choices.text: How long has this thing been in disrepair?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Very long. It fell apart before the box did, and the box fell into ruin ages ago.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you don't know at all, do you...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Hah. I do not particularly follow how many times the sun rises or sets.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we should have some stuff left over from when we were fixing that Offering Box, right?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Of such things, I cannot be sure... Why do you humans love wood so much, anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, you know what, never mind... Paimon remembers that we have some spares. Let's look around a bit.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Whatever the case may be, I shall leave the matter of the wooden shelf to you. This shrine will not take care of itself, after all, meow.

choices.text: It has nothing to do with the material, per se...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: That Prayer Rack looks like it's been kaput for a very long time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Oh, hello there, Traveler. Miss Etsuko and I are currently investigating the area around this shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Even though the various shrine facilities have long fallen into ruin... It does have them all nonetheless.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: People from the nearby villages must have all come to this place to pay respects. I suppose that its ruin must have something to do with the abandoned Koseki Village...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow, meow, meow... That wooden shelf...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've fixed it.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Oho! Have you indeed? Ah, this shrine looks yet more the part now! Meow, meow!

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Now then, go and tell those two green humans that the shelf has been fixed, and that they can now hang wooden blocks on it. And while they are at it, they can bring some other people to come and pay respects and stuff the box with Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not going to tell them yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: No! Th—That green, tall human is very scary. H—He can read the hearts of cats... My guise is no match for his keen eyes! Meow, meow!

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Not to mention how he gets far too excited each time he talks to me... Meow, meow...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Hello there, Traveler. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Prayer Rack's been fixed.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: It is? You fixed it? You're a kind soul, aren't you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I was commissioned by the provisional head priestess.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: L—Lady Neko commissioned you to do it?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Has she noticed our actions, then?

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Miss Etsuko! Let's go over to where the Prayer Rack is!

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: First the Offering Box, now the Prayer Rack...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: This provisional head priestess really is serious about repairing the shrine, huh...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: But the inhabitants around these parts all migrated long ago.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: In short, no one on this island's coming to pay respects at this shrine but us.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: What are you trying to say, Miss Etsuko?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: ...Has that provisional head priestess realized this yet? What motive does it have for repairing that shrine?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: ...Never mind, maybe I'm just letting my suspicion get the better of me. We can go over to that Prayer Rack, no problem.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: But I'd call remaining on guard the right option.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Miss Etsuko, Lady Neko is just a cat...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: You did a beautiful job repairing this Prayer Rack.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: But the Prayer Plaques... You can't see what they say at all. How long has it been since...

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Miss Etsuko! I found a few wooden planks nearby, and I, ah, carved us a few Prayer Plaques.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Since this Prayer Rack's been repaired, it needs some Prayer Plaques hung on it, after all.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Do you have any wishes, Miss Etsuko? I can draw them out for you.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Hanging a Prayer Plaque up at this shrine...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Hehe, what an interesting thought. Pass me one of those plaques, I'll handle the drawing myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, looks like they're preparing to put some Prayer Plaques up, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go tell Neko. It'll be pleased for sure!

choices.text: I just know a few tricks.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I have espied those two green humans preparing to hang up Prayer Plaques. You are indeed a reliable pair.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Well, once they're done, I am sure that they will inform other humans, and that those will visit this shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow, meow, meow... It seems that besides "cleanup" and fixing that box, this rack, too, is very important.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Good, very good. Meow meow meow! At this rate, the shrine will surely be restored to liveliness.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you want to restore the shrine, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Unya, meow... Why, indeed... I am the provisional head priestess, after all. It is my duty to care for the shrine, to have many people pay respects here, to make this shrine a lively place.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Also, Hibiki would be most grieved should she return and find this shrine all broken-down.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow, meow, but with your aid, it shall surely return to its former glory in no time at all.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I might still require your help from time to time, meow. Don't you decline when the time comes, now.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Go tell those two green humans that the shelf has been fixed, and that they can now hang their little wooden blocks on it.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow, meow... If they could tell more people of the repairs made, perhaps still more people might come...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: My wish, huh... Well then, let's go with "I wish to live comfortably." How about that?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Hmm, what should I write? Something about becoming a successful adventurer, perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I might still require your help after some time, meow. Don't you decline when the time comes, now, meow.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Hi. Need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two doing?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Investigating this shrine's surroundings... Well, that's Taisuke's idea, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: As far as I'm concerned, this is just an opportunity to slack off for a moment.
